subject: Discovery follow-up: schedule demo & loop in security/procurement

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: dev.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery follow-up: schedule demo & loop in security/procurement

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery: 
- Primary use case: semantic search + summarization for financial reports (low-latency API, private deployment for PII)
- Key constraints: SOC 2 evidence, VPN/VPC networking, and predictable monthly throughput for quarterly reporting jobs
- Success metric: 50% reduction in per-query latency and 30% cost reduction vs current infra

Next steps I recommend:
1) Schedule a 60-min technical deep dive (platform + networking + security) with your platform and security teams
2) Share a mutual action plan and SOC2 questionnaire (attached)
3) Identify procurement contact for contracting and any SSO/KMS requirements

Availability (PST) next week for a 60-min deep dive: 
- Tue 10/13: 10:00-11:00, 15:00-16:00
- Wed 10/14: 09:00-11:00
- Thu 10/15: 13:00-16:00

Could you loop in whoever will own security/procurement and confirm a preferred slot? I’ve attached a short mutual_action_plan.pdf and a demo_prep_slide.pdf to help prep.

If preferred, we can do a shorter 30-min product demo first, then follow with the technical deep dive.

Thanks — looking forward to getting your platform/security folks synced.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.pdf, demo_prep_slide.pdf
